en: The postcard features a colorized photograph of a historical square or park with a prominent ornate fountain at its center, surrounded by lush gardens, decorative street lamps, and people strolling or sitting. Behind the fountain are large, stately buildings with elaborate facades typical of late 19th to early 20th-century European architecture. The reverse side contains pre-printed and handwritten Swedish text, with 'BREFKORT' at the top and is addressed to Emma Eliasson in Lund. The front of the card also includes handwritten Swedish greetings.
